List valid Google Slides shape types

Source: R/utils.R
gs_shape_types.Rd

Returns a character vector of all shape type strings accepted by the Google Slides API's createShape request. Pass any of these values as the shape_type argument of add_create_shape_request().

Usage

gs_shape_types()

Value

A character vector of valid shape type strings.

Examples

gs_shape_types()
#>   [1] "TEXT_BOX"                      "RECTANGLE"                    
#>   [3] "ROUND_RECTANGLE"               "ELLIPSE"
